name: Moonmancer halves Starcall's cooldown (#2217)
contract: Moonmancer 680810 (Spell.dbc, family 32) tooltip: "Reduces the cooldown of Starcall by $s1%." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11), EffectBasePoints -51 with DieSides 1 (=-50), EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x20000000, which matches every Starcall rank read (800497, 502316, 502317, 302568, 302569: family 32, word1 0x20000000, Category 753, RecoveryTime 0, CategoryRecoveryTime 12000, no SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS in Attributes Ex6). Native path: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns runs ApplySpellMod(spell, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, catrec) on a positive category recovery (Player.cpp), so the 12000 ms category cooldown becomes 6000. spell_modifier op 11 on the real 12000 base is that exact call without casting (a Starcall cast depends on target, resources and hit rolls that add nothing to the contract); Lunar Lance 502340 is the negative control and the twin without the passive proves the baseline stays 12000. Values read 2026-09-21 from the shipped /srv/coa/server-data/dbc/Spell.dbc.
